analysis.title: Early Morning Reid - Macro Strategy (12 November 2026)
key_insights: S&P 500 closed +1.31% at 7619, back above its pre-midterm level. CoreWeave's earnings (stock +24.71%, biggest daily jump since June 2025) drove a tech rally, with the Philly semiconductor index +5.66% and the Nasdaq Composite +1.6%.

After the US close the WSJ reported that the Nvidia board is planning to oust CEO Jensen Huang. Nvidia fell -8.6% in after-hours trading, and Nasdaq and S&P futures are lower (-1.09% and -0.45% per the report).

Asian equities are lower on the Nvidia story: Kospi -1.04%, Hang Seng -0.86%, Nikkei -0.78%, Shanghai Comp -0.22%. DAX futures are +0.66%, which the author reads as a hint of rotation away from US tech.
European equities rose, with the DAX +1.20%, FTSE 100 +0.78%, STOXX 600 +0.72% and CAC 40 +0.66%. The DAX and STOXX 600 hit records, and the STOXX 600 high is its first since August.
CoreWeave is viewed as a bellwether of the AI trade because of its heavy debt burden and capital-intensive data-centre leasing model. The stock is still about -45% below its August levels.

The hawkish implications of Tuesday's CPI print continued to feed into Fed funds futures while US Treasuries were closed for the holiday. December meeting pricing rose to 28.5bps and September 2027 pricing rose +7bps to 82bps, then eased to 77bps overnight.
A more hawkish Fed pushed the dollar index (+0.66%) to its highest since April 2025. EUR/USD fell -0.66% to an 18-month low, closing around $1.109.
Brent rose +1.2% on Wednesday with no obvious headline driver, then fell about 1% overnight to roughly where it was a day earlier. Higher oil lifted 1yr Euro inflation swaps +9.3bps to 3.02%.

ECB pricing turned more hawkish: hikes priced by the July 2027 meeting rose +3bps to 63.5bps and 2yr German yields rose +1.7bps to 3.11%. The 10yr Bund yield fell -0.2bps to 3.31%, with OATs -2.1bps and BTPs -3.8bps, a flatter curve.

Russia-Ukraine: US envoys Witkoff and Kushner met Putin in Moscow. Officials cited some progress, a sizable prisoner exchange was agreed, and territory remains the key sticking point. The US delegation is set to meet Zelenskyy next.
Japan October PPI rose +7.1% y/y, above the +6.5% consensus and September's +6.8%. The author hopes it declines if the recent oil price falls hold.

Day ahead: UK Q3 GDP, US existing home sales and weekly jobless claims, a $25bn 30yr Treasury auction, and Fed speakers Hammack, Barr, Goolsbee, Daly and Williams. ECB speakers are Lagarde, Vujcic and Nagel. Applied Materials and Cisco report earnings, and US PPI is due tomorrow.
